AboutMe.paragraph1: Doctoral candidate at the Institute of Political and Security Studies (US), psychology student. I research separatism and international security, plus criminology, victimology and EMDR psychotherapy.

PsychoterapiaPage.metaDescription: Information about my psychotherapy training, approach and future practice.
PsychoterapiaPage.intro: For me, psychotherapy is a space where theory meets the person — their history, relationships and capacity for change.
PsychoterapiaPage.warningText: I am currently in psychotherapy training — I do not yet run a practice or see clients. This page is for informational purposes only. If you are in crisis or your life or health is at risk, call the emergency number 999 or contact a crisis helpline for adults in emotional distress: 116 123.

szkolenie.heading: Four years, one goal
szkolenie.p1: Since September 2026 I have been enrolled in a four-year psychotherapy programme accredited by the Scientific Section of Psychotherapy and Family Therapy of the Polish Psychiatric Association.
szkolenie.p2: The training comprises over 1,080 teaching hours — lectures, workshops, supervision and personal therapeutic experience. Sessions are held on weekends.

podejscie.heading: Integrative-psychodynamic orientation
podejscie.p1: I work within the integrative-psychodynamic orientation, which combines classical psychoanalytic foundations with contemporary clinical approaches. The programme includes:
list: Object relations theory and attachment theory
podejscie.emdrLine: The EMDR method (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) for trauma work — recommended by the WHO
podejscie.p2: My clinical interests focus particularly on trauma, victimization, anxiety disorders and neurodiversity.

dlaKogo.heading: Eventually: adults
dlaKogo.p1: I plan to work with adults, particularly around trauma (including secondary trauma and victimization), anxiety disorders, relationship difficulties, and the search for meaning and identity. My research background in criminology and victimology provides additional context for understanding clients' specific experiences.

wyksztalcenie.heading: An interdisciplinary context
wyksztalcenie.p1: I combine a background in law and political science (a doctorate at the University of Szczecin) with ongoing training in psychology (integrated studies). This combination lets me view people within a broad context — systemic, legal and interpersonal.
wyksztalcenie.p2: My psychotherapy training adds clinical competence and a practical skill set for working with another person.

questions3: Dlaczego idee separatystyczne stają się realnym zagrożeniem?
Czy profil psychologiczny może pomóc przewidzieć mechanizm przemocy?
Jak projektować prewencję, która działa zanim pojawi się kryzys?

ResearchPage.closingHeading: Badania mają znaczenie wtedy, gdy zmieniają sposób działania.
ResearchPage.closingBody: Jeśli chcesz porozmawiać o współpracy, projektach badawczych lub zastosowaniu wyników w praktyce, zapraszam do kontaktu.
ResearchPage.approachHeading: Łączę rygor metodologiczny z wrażliwością na kontekst.
ResearchPage.approachBody: Opieram się na triangulacji danych, krytycznej analizie źródeł i podejściu interdyscyplinarnym. Pytam o mechanizmy, nie tylko o korelacje — i zawsze o znaczenie wyników dla praktyki.
researchQuestions: Jak instytucje mogą skuteczniej chronić, nie reprodukując krzywdy?
Jak identyfikować zagrożenia bez naruszania praw jednostki?
Jak trauma kształtuje decyzje, relacje i zachowania społeczne?
Jak wspierać zdrowienie i odporność w społecznościach po konflikcie?

OMniePage.metaDescription: Researcher, published author and psychotherapist in training. I combine psychology, criminology and security research with a background in international management and business.

hero.heading: Bringing together research, psychotherapy and practice.
hero.paragraph1: I am a doctoral candidate at the Institute of Political and Security Studies at the University of Szczecin, a psychology student, and a participant in a four-year psychotherapy training programme. I combine an interest in people and social processes with experience gained in international management, procurement and renewable energy.
hero.paragraph2: My academic work focuses on separatism, international security and the Western Balkans, as well as criminology, victimology and security psychology. In my psychotherapy training I work within the integrative-psychodynamic orientation, developing my practice in trauma work through the EMDR method.
